name: Team Bulbasaur: Grass Momentum & Aerial Breakers
archetype: Special Grass/Flying starter aerial pivot, Ground physical breakers, and high-velocity Psychic artillery.
gym_duel_rationale: Koga enforces a strict 4v4 duel. Enter the arena with Venusaur/Fearow (500 BST Grass/Flying powerhouse quad-resisting Bug and immune to Toxic Spikes and Ground moves; STAB Drill Peck cleanly OHKOs Beedrill/Scyther and Venomoth/Grimer), Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST Ground/Fighting breaker whose Vital Spirit ignores sleep while STAB Magnitude and Close Combat punish Poison targets), Arcanine/Gloom (Fire/Poison quad-resisting Bug and Fairy with STAB Flamethrower and Extreme Speed priority), and Kadabra/Haunter (407 BST with 118 SpA, Levitate Ground immunity, and STAB Psychic to easily dismantle Koga's Ace Chansey/Muk before Acid Armor stacks).

roster.progression_notes: 500 BST with 93 Speed. Quad-resists Grass and Bug, immune to Ground and Toxic Spikes. STAB Drill Peck shreds Koga's Bug/Poison lineup while Roost sustains through poison chip.
457 BST physical fortress with 101 Attack and 93 Defense. Vital Spirit grants total sleep immunity while STAB Magnitude deals heavy Ground damage to grounded Poison types.
Fire/Poison typing quad-resists Bug and Fairy while resisting Grass and Steel. STAB Flamethrower incinerates Beedrill/Scyther and Extreme Speed finishes weakened foes.
407 BST with 118 Special Attack and 98 Speed. Levitate grants Ground immunity. STAB Psychic targets Chansey/Muk's low physical defense before Acid Armor can be used.
483 BST with 103 Speed and 98 Attack. Water Absorb counters water threats on Cycling Road while natural 100 BP Earthquake provides high ground pressure.

flex_bench.why_use: Retained for capturing rare Safari Zone encounters (Chansey, Tauros, Scyther) using 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder.
Combines Thick Club Marowak physical power with Aron's 103 Base Defense, absorbing Normal and Electric attacks effortlessly.

active_fusions: Venusaur/Fearow (500 BST Grass/Flying starter with 4x STAB Drill Peck and Roost)
Primeape/Sandslash (457 BST Vital Spirit sleep-immune physical breaker)
Arcanine/Gloom (Fire/Poison quad-resisting Bug with Flamethrower and Extreme Speed)
Kadabra/Haunter (118 SpA Levitate Psychic/Poison special sweeper)
Poliwrath/Dugtrio (483 BST Water Absorb fast ground sweeper with 103 Speed)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Maintain current fusions through Fuchsia City; the roster hard-counters Koga's Bug/Poison setup.
2. Once Linking Cords are acquired from 15 Hotel Quests, unfuse Kadabra/Haunter at any Mart ($300) to evolve Kadabra into Alakazam and Haunter into Gengar before re-splicing.
upcoming_fusions: Venusaur/Alakazam (Psychic Grass titan for Gym 6 Sabrina)
